user.title: Connect SmartFriends Box
user.description: Enter the address of your SmartFriends Box and a SmartFriends user account. The connection is local and no shutter is moved during setup.

discovery_confirm.title: Confirm SmartFriends Box
discovery_confirm.description: Found {name} at {host}. Enter the credentials for this box. No shutter is moved during setup.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The SmartFriends Box rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current password.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure {name}
reconfigure.description: Change the address or user name of this SmartFriends Box. The stored password is validated again.
